_comment: Tags that mean opposite things. Two words, each wanting one side of a pair, contradict each other
wherever they are laid (Register.OPPOSED) and are charged as a tension where the world held both.
From `aquatic` down (Jonah, 2026-10-04): every pair has words on both sides, since a pair nobody can
write charges nothing -- contradiction is what the instability ladder is climbed by.

Not pairs, because the Art's own books write both sides together without contradiction: aquatic against dry or molten (fish in a scorching Age), flowering against barren (flowers in an arid one), solid against eroded (worn ground over unbroken rock).
